So the people of Judah gathered to seek the LORD, and indeed, they came from all the cities of Judah to seek Him.

xrefs.text: Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
The nations rage like the rush of many waters. He rebukes them, and they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweeds before a gale.
The LORD has exhausted His wrath; He has poured out His fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has consumed her foundations.
Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke through an open window.

verses.text: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice. Seek righteousness; seek humility. Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD’s anger.

xrefs.text: Seek good, not evil, so that you may live. And the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be with you, as you have claimed.
Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed.
when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!

verses.text: For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon left in ruins. Ashdod will be driven out at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.

xrefs.text: Ashkelon will see and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, as will Ekron, for her hope will wither. There will cease to be a king in Gaza, and Ashkelon will be uninhabited.

verses.text: “I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.

xrefs.text: Tell the Ammonites to hear the word of the Lord GOD, for this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you exclaimed, “Aha!” when My sanctuary was profaned, when the land of Israel was laid waste, and when the house of Judah went into exile,
saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of the Ammonites, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to enlarge their territory.
Was not Israel your object of ridicule? Was he ever found among thieves? For whenever you speak of him you shake your head.
Concerning the Ammonites, this is what the LORD says: “Has Israel no sons? Is he without heir? Why then has Milcom taken possession of Gad? Why have his people settled in their cities?

verses.text: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.”

xrefs.text: On that day the LORD will become King over all the earth— the LORD alone, and His name alone.

verses.text: This carefree city that dwells securely, that thinks to herself: “I am it, and there is none besides me,” what a ruin she has become, a resting place for beasts. Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist.

xrefs.text: “Son of man, tell the ruler of Tyre that this is what the Lord GOD says: Your heart is proud, and you have said, ‘I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods in the heart of the sea.’ Yet you are a man and not a god, though you have regarded your heart as that of a god.
Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who slay you? You will be only a man, not a god, in the hands of those who wound you.
O city of commotion, O town of revelry? Your slain did not die by the sword, nor were they killed in battle.
You said, ‘I will be queen forever.’ You did not take these things to heart or consider their outcome.
There is no healing for your injury; your wound is severe. All who hear the news of you applaud your downfall, for who has not experienced your constant cruelty?
